feedback: The confession follows the pre-vote contradiction closely: Paige admits relocating tonight's interview to yesterday to hide access to the waiting glass. That makes the reveal feel earned and lets the source-protection motive land as a moral failure rather than a triumphant justification. Her taking poison at the preview and returning alone are new admissions of the actual mechanics; those specific acts were not independently established beforehand. They confirm the inferred route rather than overturn it, but explain why my confidence stopped short of certainty. Monet and Chip's explanations close their competing lies convincingly, and Chip's final request to photograph everything preserves his voice. The restrained source line is emotionally stronger than a long speech explaining every clue.
new_decisive_facts: Paige explicitly took poison at the preview and returned alone to Grant's place after he rejoined the reception; these precise acts were not independently shown before voting.
